behavior: Normal links require the loaded account, student and document revision before private reads; cached incomplete intent and changed accounts fail before IO.
Caller-scoped row security, canonical explicit student access, document view access, partner-only exclusion and central authorization are required. Archived reads also require editing access.
Only clean/not-infected, undeleted files on the exact student path are eligible. Source identity/revision/readiness/access are rechecked after mint and audit.
Returned capability must use HTTPS and the configured backend origin, exact bucket/path and a nonempty token, with no credentials or fragment. Expiry remains300seconds.
No automatic remint/retry after lost replies, failed audits or changed authority. Audit metadata excludes URL/token/title/path/email.
Denied initial attempts use the caller audit client with an unconfirmed reason; no privileged existence/profile probe or private existence disclosure.
The unused authenticated admin override endpoint always refuses before data/grant/Storage IO, including existing cached requests and platform roles.
Both download and goal-reading callers supply intent; departed download responses/errors are ignored and concurrent download clicks are blocked.
Permission, read, signing and audit replies require explicit null error fields; missing status is unconfirmed, not success.

database_exception.required_next_step: Reproduce direct authenticated grant access in disposable SQL, prepare narrowly reviewed retirement that preserves explicit student/document access and legitimate registration reads, then prove denial including existing unexpired grants. No hosted installation is authorized.

limits: Application retirement is not database grant retirement. Cached/direct SQL/Storage clients may still exercise the canonical legacy exception until separately reviewed schema changes are deployed.
Already minted URLs remain bearer capabilities until expiry; refusing a later response does not revoke a created capability.
Post-mint rechecks do not provide transaction-held access-removal serialization or immutable physical-byte proof.
Audit writes are separate statements; an uncertain audit/mint may have committed and is never automatically replayed here.
The enriched privileged iep_access_alerts existence-probe path is replaced by caller-scoped audit of an unconfirmed attempt. Confirm alert consumers/monitoring before launch.
No hosted acceptance, provider IO, schema changes or fresh native replay occurred. Historical SQL proof remains only for unchanged SQL.
